title: JEVPA on fresh Bias in Bios journalist-professor data
description: Given the Bias in Bios train parquet and the previously used journalist-professor task IDs, when a new deterministic source-disjoint corpus is frozen before analyst or Jev calls, then compare diversity-gated Pareto retention with greedy search on journalist versus professor classification. Discovery, selection, and test labels remain separated; analyst sees discovery labels only. Retention requires a distinct sealed-slice winner and meaningful prediction diversity, preventing the Civil Comments failure mode of near-identical slice specialists.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Completed and documented on branch `codex/journalist-professor-jevpa` at `4e83e66`.

The pre-registered study stopped after shared initial selection: three valid academic-focused candidates were all dominated by `scholarly_research_output`, with pairwise correlation 0.9992–0.9999 and hard disagreement at most 0.005. No pair satisfied the pre-registered diversity gate, so no branch or held-out requests were made. This is a negative mechanism result: it does not demonstrate a JEVPA benefit on this second real source, but the gate prevented an unsupported merge.
